items.title_cn: 中性粒细胞-淋巴细胞比值对急性胰腺炎患者不良预后的临床意义
items.title_en: Clinical Significance of the Neutrophil-Lymphocyte Ratio as a Prognostic Marker for Adverse Outcomes in Patients with Acute Pancreatitis
items.abstract_cn: 目的：评估中性粒细胞-淋巴细胞比值（NLR）在急性胰腺炎患者中的预后价值，并确定其在预测疾病严重程度和不良结局中的 usefulness。材料与方法：一项前瞻性横断面研究，纳入50例确诊为急性胰腺炎的患者。分别在第0天、第1天和第2天计算NLR，并在CT严重程度分组间进行比较。统计分析采用方差分析和卡方检验。结果：轻度和中度病例中NLR下降，而重度病例中NLR显著升高。各组间差异具有高度统计学显著性（P < 0.01）。较高的NLR与更长的住院时间和器官功能障碍相关。结论：NLR是一种简单、经济且可靠的标志物，可用于急性胰腺炎严重程度的早期评估和预后判断。
items.abstract_en: Objectives: To evaluate the prognostic value of the neutrophil–lymphocyte ratio (NLR) in patients with acute pancreatitis and to determine its usefulness in predicting disease severity and adverse outcomes. Material and Methods: A prospective cross-sectional study including 50 patients diagnosed with acute pancreatitis. NLR was calculated on day 0, day 1, and day 2 and compared across CT severity groups. Statistical analysis was performed using ANOVA and chi-square tests. Results: NLR declined in mild and moderate cases but increased significantly in severe cases. The difference among groups was statistically highly significant (P < 0.01). Higher NLR was associated with longer hospital stay and organ dysfunction. Conclusion: NLR is a simple, cost-effective and reliable marker for early assessment of severity and prognosis in acute pancreatitis.
items.summary_cn: NLR在重症急性胰腺炎中显著升高，与住院时间延长和器官功能障碍相关，可作为早期评估严重程度和预后的简单、经济、可靠的标志物。

items.title_cn: 血浆置换治疗高甘油三酯血症急性胰腺炎的疗效与风险：系统综述与荟萃分析的补充材料
items.title_en: Supplemental Material for: Therapeutic Outcomes and Risks of Plasmapheresis in Hypertriglyceridemia Acute Pancreatitis: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
items.abstract_cn: 引言：高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）的发病率持续上升，且重症比例较高。血浆置换作为HTG-AP治疗干预手段的获益仍存在争议。因此，我们进行了一项荟萃分析，检索现有证据以评估其有效性和安全性。方法：在主要电子数据库中进行全面文献检索，根据预设标准筛选符合条件的研究。纳入的研究比较了血浆置换联合标准药物治疗（血浆置换组，PE组）与单纯标准药物治疗（对照组）在HTG-AP患者中的疗效。研究结局包括24小时血清甘油三酯（TG）降低率、院内死亡率、局部/全身并发症发生率、住院时间（LOS）、住院费用及复发率。结果：共检索到986篇文章，纳入20项研究，涉及1，576例患者（PE组：n=636；对照组：n=940）。分析显示，PE组与对照组在死亡率（RR 1.43，95%CI 0.91-2.26，P=0.12）、全身并发症发生率（RR：0.96；95%CI：0.61-1.50；P=0.86）、局部并发症发生率（RR 1.01，95% CI 0.84-1.21；P=0.91）及需要侵入性操作的比例（RR 0.86，95% CI 0.48-1.54，P=0.62）方面差异均无统计学意义。与对照组相比，PE组在24小时（SMD 10.13，95% CI 3.39-16.87，P<0.01）和48小时（SMD 8.14，95%CI 4.30-11.98，P<0.0001）的TG降低幅度均更高。PE组住院时间延长（WMD 2.40，95%CI 0.14-4.66，P=0.04），同时费用显著增加（WMD 27.56，95%CI 16.61-38.51，P<0.00001）。亚组分析显示，血浆置换增加了非重症患者的死亡率。结论：虽然血浆置换能显著降低血清TG水平，但对HTG-AP的关键临床结局无显著获益。因此，现有临床证据不支持将其作为HTG-AP的常规治疗手段。应开展大规模随机对照试验以进一步评估其疗效、最佳适应证和时机。关键词：血浆置换；血浆交换；双重滤过血浆置换；高甘油三酯血症性急性胰腺炎；荟萃分析。
items.abstract_en: Introduction: Hypertriglyceridemia acute pancreatitis (HTG-AP) is constantly increasing and has a higher proportion of severe cases. The benefit of plasmapheresis as a therapeutic intervention for HTG-AP remains controversial. Thus we conducted a meta-analysis to search existing evidence to evaluate its efficacy and safety. Methods: A comprehensive literature search was performed in key electronic databases to search eligible studies based on predetermined criteria. Included studies compared plasmapheresis combined with standard medical therapy (Plasmapheresis group, PE group) versus standard medical therapy alone (Control group) in HTG-AP patients. Study outcomes were 24-hour serum triglyceride (TG) reduction rate, in-hospital mortality, incidence of local/systemic complications, hospital length of stay (LOS), hospitalization costs, and recurrence rate. Results: A total of 986 articles were retrieved and 20 studies involving 1,576 patients (PE group: n=636; Control group: n=940) were included. Analysis revealed that no statistically significant difference was found in mortality (RR 1.43, 95%CI 0.91-2.26, P=0.12), incidence of systemic complications (RR: 0.96; 95%CI: 0.61-1.50; P = 0.86), incidence of local complications (RR 1.01, 95% CI 0.84-1.21; P=0.91) , requirement for invasive procedures (RR 0.86, 95% CI 0.48-1.54, P=0.62) between PE group and Control group. PE group has higher TG reduction at both 24h (SMD 10.13, 95% CI 3.39-16.87, P<0.01) and 48h (SMD 8.14, 95%CI 4.30-11.98, P<0.0001) compared with control group. PE group exhibited a prolonged LOS (WMD 2.40, 95%CI 0.14-4.66, P=0.04) alongside substantially increased costs (WMD 27.56, 95%CI 16.61-38.51, P<0.00001). Subgroup analysis indicated plasmapheresis increased mortality in non-severe cases. Conclusion: While plasmapheresis significantly reduces serum TG levels, it confers no significant benefit on critical clinical outcomes in HTG-AP. Thus existing clinical evidence does not support its use as a routine treatment for HTG-AP. Large-scale RCTs should be carried out to further evaluate its efficacy, optimal indications, and timing. Key words: plasmapheresis; plasma exchange; double filtration plasmapheresis; hypertriglyceridemic acute pancreatitis; meta-analysis.
items.summary_cn: 该meta分析显示，血浆置换虽能显著降低高甘油三酯血症急性胰腺炎（HTG-AP）患者的血清甘油三酯水平，但并未改善死亡率、局部或全身并发症等关键临床结局，反而延长住院时间并增加费用，因此现有证据不支持将其作为HTG-AP的常规治疗。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎严重程度评估中的全球免疫-营养-炎症指数（GINI）：一项比较研究
items.title_en: The Global Immune-Nutrition-Inflammation Index (GINI) in Acute Pancreatitis Severity Assessment: A Comparative Study
items.summary_cn: 该研究提出并比较了全球免疫-营养-炎症指数（GINI）在急性胰腺炎严重程度评估中的价值，但摘要未提供具体结果或结论。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎胰周积液CT自动体积测量用于风险分层：多中心回顾性研究
items.title_en: Automated CT Volumetry of Peripancreatic Collections for Risk Stratification in Acute Pancreatitis: A Multicenter Retrospective Study.

items.title_cn: FTO介导的m6A修饰通过下调1,2-二亚油酰-GPC（18:2/18:2）抑制急性胰腺炎：一项整合多组学的机制研究。
items.title_en: FTO-mediated m6A modification suppresses acute pancreatitis by downregulating 1,2-dilinoleoyl-GPC (18:2/18:2): An integrated multi-omics mechanistic study.
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种常见的临床急症，其病理生理机制尚不明确。既往研究提示N6-甲基腺苷（m6A）修饰参与AP的发病过程，但确切的分子机制仍不清楚。代谢物是否参与该过程也是一个重要且尚未解决的问题。为探究可能的因果通路，我们整合了多组学数据。我们从文献中筛选出m6A相关基因，并将这些基因与AP的遗传汇总统计资料、表达数量性状位点（eQTL）数据以及公共数据库中1400种血浆代谢物信息相结合，构建了基于这些数据的因果推断框架。采用孟德尔随机化和中介孟德尔随机化方法，系统评估了m6A相关基因、代谢物与AP风险之间的因果关系。为验证结果的可靠性，我们进行了留一法敏感性分析、异质性检验和水平多效性检验。我们发现脂肪量和肥胖相关（FTO）eQTL与AP风险显著负相关（比值比[OR] = 0.78，95%置信区间[CI]：0.66-0.93，P < .01）。此外，我们发现FTO eQTL降低了1,2-二亚油酰-甘油磷酸胆碱（1,2-二亚油酰-GPC，18:2/18:2）的水平（OR = 0.89，95% CI：0.80-0.99，P < .05），而该代谢物水平升高会增加AP风险（OR = 1.22，95% CI：1.08-1.39，P < .01）。因此，我们构建并验证了名为“FTO-m6A-1,2-二亚油酰-GPC（18:2/18:2）”的调控轴：FTO介导的去甲基化通过降低m6A修饰水平，进而降低循环中1,2-二亚油酰-GPC（18:2/18:2）的水平，从而抑制AP的发生。这是我们首次在AP中发现“FTO-m6A-1,2-二亚油酰-GPC（18:2/18:2）”调控轴。我们发现FTO可能通过刺激m6A依赖性转录后机制促进磷脂代谢重编程，从而进一步抑制疾病发展。这些发现为AP的发病过程提供了新的见解，也为靶向治疗提供了新方向。
items.abstract_en: The pathophysiology of acute pancreatitis (AP), a common clinical emergency, is poorly understood. Previous studies have implicated N6-methyladenosine (m6A) modification in the pathogenesis of AP; however, the precise molecular mechanisms remain unclear. Whether metabolites participate in this process is also an important, unresolved question. To investigate the possible causal pathways, we integrated multi-omics data. We identified m6A related genes from literature and combined these genes with genetic summary statistics of AP, expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) data, and information on 1400 plasma metabolites from public databases. We constructed a causal inference framework based on these data. The causal relationship between m6A-related genes, metabolites, and AP risk was systematically evaluated using Mendelian randomization and mediating Mendelian randomization methods. To validate the reliability of our results, we performed leave-one-out sensitivity, heterogeneity tests, and horizontal pleiotropy. We found that the fat mass and obesity (FTO) eQTL was significantly negatively correlated with AP risk (odds ratio [OR] = 0.78, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.66-0.93, P < .01). In addition, we found that the FTO eQTL reduced the level of 1,2-dilinoleoyl-glycerophosphocholine (1,2-dilinoleoyl-GPC, 18:2/18:2; OR = 0.89, 95% CI: 0.80-0.99, P < .05) and that a high level of this metabolite increased the risk of AP (OR = 1.22, 95% CI: 1.08-1.39, P < .01). Therefore, we constructed and verified a regulatory axis named "FTO-m6A-1,2-dilinoleoyl-GPC (18:2/18:2) ": Through its role in diminishing m6A modification levels, FTO-mediated demethylation lowers circulating 1,2-dilinoleoyl-GPC (18:2/18:2), which contributes to the suppression of AP. This is the first time that we have discovered the "FTO-m6A-1,2-dilinoleoyl-GPC (18:2/18:2)" regulatory axis in AP. We found that FTO may promotes phospholipid metabolic reprogramming by stimulating an m6A-dependent posttranscriptional mechanism, which further inhibited disease development. These findings provide new insights into the process of AP and new directions for targeted therapy.
items.summary_cn: 该研究通过多组学整合分析发现FTO介导的m6A修饰通过下调1,2-二亚油酰-GPC (18:2/18:2)水平来抑制急性胰腺炎的发生，并构建了'FTO-m6A-1,2-dilinoleoyl-GPC'调控轴，为急性胰腺炎的发病机制和靶向治疗提供了新见解。

items.title_cn: 度洛西汀通过调节SP相关神经激肽信号及PAR2/TRPV1通路，改善急性胰腺炎相关炎症并调控疼痛相关神经炎症通路
items.title_en: Duloxetine ameliorates acute pancreatitis-associated inflammation and modulates pain related neuroinflammatory pathways via modulation of SP-related neurokinin signaling and PAR2/TRPV1 pathways
items.abstract_cn:
急性胰腺炎（AP）是一种炎症性胰腺疾病，常表现为神经病理性疼痛、炎症性疼痛和/或内脏痛。疼痛是胰腺炎症的医学指标，越来越多的证据表明，疼痛通过胰腺周围广泛分布的神经网络在AP进展中发挥重要作用。

本研究旨在评估度洛西汀（DUX）——一种5-羟色胺/去甲肾上腺素再摄取抑制剂（SNRI）——在L-精氨酸（L-Arg）诱导的AP及多器官损伤（MOI）中可能发挥的保护作用，并探讨DUX介导的AP神经炎症性疼痛调节的潜在作用机制。

通过腹腔注射L-Arg（100 mg/100 g）诱导大鼠AP模型，并给予两种不同剂量的DUX（10和30 mg/kg）进行治疗观察。

DUX改善了胰腺、肝脏、肺和肾脏的组织病理学结构。此外，DUX恢复了L-Arg给药后显著升高的血清胰腺酶、肝酶和肾脏生物标志物的正常水平。同时，DUX改善了组织抗氧化状态。此外，DUX降低了胰腺组织中瞬时受体电位阳离子通道亚家族V成员1（TRPV1）、蛋白酶激活受体-2（PAR2）、P物质（SP）、神经激肽、胰蛋白酶、白三烯B4（LTB4）、信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）的水平，并显著降低了TNF-α的表达。

DUX表现出镇痛、抗炎和抗氧化作用。因此，DUX是治疗AP相关神经炎症性疼痛的有前景的候选药物。DUX的镇痛和抗炎机制可能与其调节SP相关的NK信号通路及PAR2/TRPV1通路有关，提示这些通路在DUX的观察到的有益作用中可能发挥重要作用。
items.abstract_en:
Acute pancreatitis (AP) is an inflammatory pancreatic disorder, often illustrated by neuropathic, inflammatory, and/or visceral pain. Pain is a medical indicator of pancreatic inflammation and growing evidence evokes that it exerts a significant role in AP progression via the widespread neuronal network surrounding the pancreas.
 
 
 
 evaluate the possible defensive action of duloxetine (DUX), a serotonin/norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (SNRI), in L-arginine (L-Arg)- provoked AP and multiple organ injury (MOI), and to explore the potential mechanism of action of DUX-mediated modulation of neuroinflammatory pain in AP.
 
 
 
 AP was induced in rats by intraperitoneal injection of L-Arg (100 mg/100 g) and two different doses of DUX (10 and 30 mg/kg) was examined.
 
 
 
 DUX improved the histopathological architecture of the pancreas, liver, lung, and kidney. Additionally, it restored the normal levels of serum pancreatic enzymes, liver enzymes, and kidney biomarkers that were significantly elevated following L-Arg administration. In addition, DUX improved tissue antioxidant state. Moreover, DUX decreased the levels of transient receptor potential cation channel subfamily V member 1 (TRPV1), proteinase-activated receptor-2 (PAR2), substance P (SP), neurokinin, trypsin, leukotriene B4 (LTB4), signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) and significantly reduced TNF-α expression in the pancreatic tissues.
 
 
 
 DUX displayed analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. Therefore, DUX is a promising therapeutic candidate for the management of AP-related neuroinflammatory pain. The proposed analgesic and anti-inflammatory mechanisms of DUX may be linked to the modulation of SP related NK signaling and PAR2/TRPV1 pathways pointing to a possible role for these pathways in the observed beneficial action of DUX.
items.summary_cn: Duloxetine在L-精氨酸诱导的急性胰腺炎大鼠模型中表现出镇痛、抗炎和抗氧化作用，其机制可能与调节SP相关神经激肽信号及PAR2/TRPV1通路有关。

items.title_cn: 中性粒细胞外渗抑制剂在急性胰腺炎中的治疗靶点：文献综述
items.title_en: Neutrophil Extravasation Inhibitors as Therapeutic Targets in Acute Pancreatitis: A Literature Review
items.abstract_cn: 背景：急性胰腺炎仍是临床面临的重大挑战，其治疗主要局限于支持性护理。中性粒细胞驱动的炎症在疾病进展中发挥核心作用，导致胰腺损伤、全身并发症及器官衰竭。靶向中性粒细胞的募集与活化已成为潜在的治疗策略。目的：本综述综合了当前关于中性粒细胞外渗抑制剂在急性胰腺炎中应用的证据，重点关注趋化因子介导的募集通路及中性粒细胞胞外诱捕网（NET）的形成。
items.abstract_en: Background: Acute pancreatitis remains a major clinical challenge, with treatment largely limited to supportive care. Neutrophil-driven inflammation plays a central role in disease progression, contributing to pancreatic injury, systemic complications, and organ failure. Targeting neutrophil recruitment and activation has emerged as a potential therapeutic strategy. Objective: This review synthesizes current evidence on neutrophil extravasation inhibitors in acute pancreatitis, focusing on chemokine-mediated recruitment pathways and neutrophil extracellular trap (NET) formation.
items.summary_cn: 该综述聚焦中性粒细胞外渗抑制剂在急性胰腺炎中的治疗潜力，强调趋化因子介导的募集通路和中性粒细胞胞外陷阱（NET）形成在疾病进展中的核心作用。

items.title_cn: 急性胰腺炎来源的细胞外囊泡通过靶向SOD2驱动铁死亡促进急性肺损伤
items.title_en: Extracellular vesicles from acute pancreatitis promote acute lung injury by driving ferroptosis via targeting SOD2
items.abstract_cn: 摘要 急性胰腺炎相关性急性肺损伤（AP-ALI）是急性胰腺炎（AP）患者死亡的主要原因，但其确切机制尚不明确，限制了靶向治疗的发展。细胞外囊泡（EVs）正逐渐被认为是炎症性疾病中介导细胞间通讯的关键介质。本研究探讨了循环EVs及其内容物在AP-ALI中的作用，重点关注肺上皮细胞铁死亡这一新机制。通过逆行胆管输注牛磺胆酸钠建立AP-ALI大鼠模型。从对照组和AP-ALI大鼠血浆中分离EVs。通过将EVs给予AP-ALI大鼠（联合或不联合外泌体抑制剂GW4869）评估其作用。采用透射电子显微镜、生化检测（GSH、MDA、Fe²⁺）、Western blot检测GPX4和COX-2、C11-BODIPY染色检测脂质过氧化以及基于抑制剂的细胞死亡特异性实验评估铁死亡。对血浆EVs进行miRNA测序，鉴定差异表达的miRNAs。利用mimics和inhibitors在大鼠肺上皮L2细胞中体外验证miR-200c-3p的功能，并利用agomirs和antagomirs进行体内验证。靶基因预测和荧光素酶报告基因实验确定SOD2为miR-200c-3p的直接靶标。来自AP-ALI大鼠的血浆源性EVs给予受体AP-ALI大鼠后，加重了肺损伤、炎症和胰腺损伤，而GW4869可减弱这些效应。这些EVs在肺组织中诱导了铁死亡的典型特征，包括线粒体萎缩、GSH降低、MDA和Fe²⁺升高、GPX4下调及COX-2上调，而铁死亡抑制剂Fer-1可逆转这些变化。miRNA谱分析显示，miR-200c-3p在AP-ALI EVs中显著富集。体外实验中，AP-ALI EVs或miR-200c-3p过表达促进L2细胞铁死亡，而抑制miR-200c-3p则产生相反效果。机制上，miR-200c-3p直接靶向并抑制SOD2。体内实验中，miR-200c-3p agomir加重了AP-ALI和铁死亡，而其antagomir则减轻了损伤和铁死亡标志物。我们的研究结果表明，AP-ALI大鼠的循环EVs携带miR-200c-3p，并将其递送至肺上皮细胞，通过靶向抑制SOD2，从而促进铁死亡并加重肺损伤。这一EV-miR-200c-3p-SOD2-铁死亡轴揭示了AP-ALI发病机制中的新机制，并提示了潜在的治疗靶点。
items.abstract_en: Abstract Acute pancreatitis-associated acute lung injury (AP-ALI) is a major cause of mortality in AP, yet its precise mechanisms remain unclear, limiting targeted therapies. Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are emerging as key mediators of intercellular communication in inflammatory diseases. This study investigated the role of circulating EVs and their cargo in AP-ALI, focusing on the novel mechanism of ferroptosis in lung epithelial cells. A rat model of AP-ALI was established via retrograde bile duct infusion of sodium taurocholate. EVs were isolated from the plasma of control and AP-ALI rats. The role of EVs was assessed by administering them to AP-ALI rats, with or without the exosome inhibitor GW4869. Ferroptosis was evaluated using transmission electron microscopy, biochemical assays (GSH, MDA, Fe²⁺), and Western blotting for GPX4 and COX-2, C11-BODIPY staining for lipid peroxidation, and inhibitor-based cell death specificity assays. miRNA sequencing of plasma EVs identified differentially expressed miRNAs. The function of miR-200c-3p was validated in vitro in rat lung epithelial L2 cells using mimics and inhibitors, and in vivo using agomirs and antagomirs. Target prediction and luciferase reporter assays identified SOD2 as a direct target of miR-200c-3p. Plasma-derived EVs from AP-ALI rats exacerbated lung injury, inflammation, and pancreatic damage when administered to recipient AP-ALI rats, effects attenuated by GW4869. These EVs induced characteristic features of ferroptosis in lung tissue, including shrunken mitochondria, decreased GSH, increased MDA and Fe²⁺, downregulated GPX4, and upregulated COX-2, which were rescued by the ferroptosis inhibitor Fer-1. miRNA profiling revealed miR-200c-3p was significantly enriched in AP-ALI EVs. In vitro, AP-ALI EVs or miR-200c-3p overexpression promoted ferroptosis in L2 cells, while miR-200c-3p inhibition had the opposite effect. Mechanistically, miR-200c-3p directly targeted and suppressed SOD2. In vivo, miR-200c-3p agomir worsened AP-ALI and ferroptosis, whereas its antagomir alleviated injury and ferroptosis markers. Our findings demonstrate that circulating EVs from AP-ALI rats carry miR-200c-3p, which is delivered to lung epithelial cells, where it targets and inhibits SOD2, thereby promoting ferroptosis and exacerbating lung injury. This EV-miR-200c-3p-SOD2-ferroptosis axis unveils a novel mechanism in AP-ALI pathogenesis and suggests potential therapeutic targets.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现急性胰腺炎相关肺损伤大鼠血浆来源的细胞外囊泡携带miR-200c-3p，通过靶向抑制SOD2促进肺上皮细胞铁死亡，从而加重肺损伤，揭示了AP-ALI发病的新机制。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
